name: Fallback Song
description: Plays your own song in a level if the original song is not installed.

track-name.name: Track name (from tracks folder)
track-name.description: File name inside the mod's save folder /tracks, e.g. mysong.mp3. Easiest option on Android.

song-file.name: Fallback song file
song-file.description: Optional file picker. Has priority over the track name. Leave empty to skip.
